findings.claim_text: Multiplying the two reproduces the headline: 9,266 / 8,942 is 1.036, 2.31 / 1.05 is 2.20, and the product is 2.28[^3,5].
On AWS's own list, a B300 accelerator-hour costs 7.2x a Trainium2 accelerator-hour ($16.146 against $2.235)[^13].
At list, an Ironwood chip-hour costs about 1.14x a CoreWeave GB200 GPU-hour ($12.00 against $10.50)[^16,17].
